name: DrivingDojo
summary: 专为交互式驾驶世界模型构建的视频数据集，覆盖完整驾驶操作、多智能体交互和开放世界驾驶知识，并提供动作指令跟随评测。
summaryEn: A video dataset tailored to interactive driving world models, covering driving maneuvers, multi-agent interplay, open-world knowledge, and an action-instruction-following benchmark.
scale: Driving clips spanning diverse maneuvers, multi-agent interactions, and open-world knowledge
scaleZh: 覆盖多样驾驶操作、多智能体交互和开放世界知识的视频片段
organizations: The University of Hong Kong and collaborators
license: Dataset license not confirmed from the available official entries
licenseZh: 现有官方入口未确认数据许可

verdict: 交互式驾驶世界模型数据
